in_marathi.name: Dhaksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Justice
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhaksha is the god of righteousness and the ruler of the netherworld. She is the goddess of justice, duty, and righteousness. She is also the wife of Lord Indra and the mother of Lord Agni.

vedic_reference.note: Dhaksha is the name of a goddess in Hinduism, identified with the destructive aspect of the god Shiva. She is depicted as a violent, ten-armed form of Shiva, holding various weapons and carrying the decapitated head of Shiva in her lap.
